The philosophy of Auraè

Not made for a moment.
Chosen for you.

Auraè celebrates the quiet confidence of individual style. Our visual world is shaped by sculptural forms, warm and cool metallic tones and the belief that the most memorable details are often the simplest. Jewellery should complement your identity, never compete with it.

Before you order

Questions, answered.

How do I order?

Add pieces to your bag and choose “Order via Instagram DM”. Your order summary is copied and Instagram opens a chat with @aurae.edition. Paste it and send.

How do I pay?

We confirm payment options in the DM once your order is received. No payment is taken on this website.

How long does delivery take?

We share the delivery time for your pincode in the DM. Add your city when you message us.

Can I return or exchange a piece?

Message us on Instagram within 48 hours of delivery and we will help with an exchange.

Where do I use the AURAE10 code?

Mention it in your DM. We apply it to your total before sharing payment details.
